title: Lecture people must listen and they must keep it
body:
As-salamu alaikum… Audhubilahi minesh shaitana rajim…Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim Meded, ya Sultan-ulAwliya…
It is an association, it is not a lecture. Lecture people must listen and they must keep it, they must learn, they
must do, according to what they are learning. It is an obligation who attending for lecture. Lectures going to
be mostly in universities, but association is something people may come, may visit, may hear and they are
free to accept it or not. As a supermarket or such a thing, you may enter, you may look around, you are free to
buy or not. We are putting here something from spirituality, who may be interested in it may look, may hear,
may accept- free.
Therefore I am saying it is not a lecture, it is only a humble center, I am ashamed to say a center also. No,
centers gives such a important place and through a center people think that an important person is in it… No,
therefore I am saying flee market, like flee market, so simple… I am trying to be a simple one, trying to be
also humble one… even though my ego asking to be first one. But I am saying: No, you are last one. First one
it is not for you to be first one. Who is going to say I am first one if coming from Heavens a certificate that you
are first one, he has forth to say I am first one, If not coming, why you say I am first one? Who accepting from
you? Except you no one accepting you that you are first. It is important to be known. Everyone claiming to be

first one or to say I am first one, but only he is accepting. That is history of our egos, or our egos
characteristics. No one accepting to be second one. Everyone claiming to be first one or trying to make people
to accept him first one…
I was looking today at T.V. for Golden Jubilee for her Majesty Queen of England. It was a big exhibition of
uniforms and clothes, that very rare you can catch such an exhibition in our days, no. And I don't think that
should be another 5o years anniversary for a King or Queen. According to our information that is coming
through Prophet's knowledge, reaching to me also, that no time for any king or queen to reach to make even
silver Jubilee, can't be for anyone 5o years for kingdom to reach Golden Jubilee. Just finished. Therefore I
was there to look to be a witness for the last Golden Jubilee just taking place on earth before Last Day, before
Day of Judgment- just finished… There, our masters making me to look, to be witness, and I was looking,
perhaps 1½ hours or 2 hours looking and seeing that it was… just I said a dressing exhibition… for men and
women… from every rank, from every nation that invited also to attend Her Majesty Queens Golden Jubilee,
and I was reached her grandfather's Jubilee… you don't know… Just I was attending her Majesty Queens
Grandfather's Jubilee, and they gave to me, I was elementary school student, I have been given also a medal
for that occasion… look… and her grandfather only reached for silver Jubilee, but that time no TV, even no
radio. Only some pictures and it was so rare to reach to us, but it was a big ceremony in Nicosia and other
cities also for that… Subhanallah… and then coming her father. After His Majesty Kind George the 5th and
Indian Emperor he was. He passed away and coming his crown prince, His Majesty Edward the 8th. And he
was not accepting the traditional rules that he must marry from royal family and he was in love with an
ordinary lady and he was only for a short time before coronation, when he was insisting, he left his crown and
to be king of England and Indian Emperor and went after that lady. Finished. Coming second, younger
brother, His Majesty King George the 6th- and his coronation I was ready and I have been given also a medal
for that occasion- that he passed away, and her Majesty Queen coming, perhaps coming like my age or less…
must be 78, 79… in my age- same day my birthday with her Majesty Queen Elizabeth… Now from that time,
coronation up today just passed 50 years… Allahu akbar… I am getting younger… look… I am not making this
beard white in mill factory… As it is yesterday now in my eyes I am looking… 'God save the King', we were
singing their national hymn… I prayed for him and for her now 50 years… Eh- American...? No king, no
value… American… what is your value? England- Sultanante, Kingdom, royalty!…

What we were saying?… It was a gallery for every kind of clothes… brilliant display… and, o my attenders…
this is like old comic show people sitting and laughing… but people are saying this is a center for most
important international and universal mental house here… That is true, doesn't matter… All of you one kind
of crazy ones, coming to me. I am first director or general director for this center or mental house. 'Mental
house center' doesn't matter, I am accepting…
Millions of people crowded in London, that means people like Sultanate, Kingdom! Your President coming,
going, and people think he is a municipal worker… Yes, President of US, if coming he is coming and getting
through people, and people ask, if not knowing like me: 'Who is the President?' That he is sometimes putting
a helmet for looking after mines and buildings… I am asking: 'Who is? That one is? Looks like foreman.'
Sultanate- people like it! They showed that through their hearts there is this love and respect to their Queens
and Kings, and everyone belonging to royal family also; people are very happy to look them and to salute
them…, you are with your King or not? If not accepting, I am making a way to be thrown away from UK
everyone, who is not accepting Her Majesty Queen there!
Democracy?… You find through your holy Books democracy? Who is saying this? Big cheating for people! All
democratic people now this century going to finish and vanish…, you must be with her Majesty Queen! If
your heart not saying, cheating me, I am throwing you over ice pole to be with bear… eating you… like
hamburger!
Allah Allah… People enjoying with clothes, enjoying with their outlookings. That is our egos' aspect, egos'
desire… everyone asking to show that he is first one or she is first one. And if those clothes are taken from
them, what is remaining? Naked bodies never show a respect to anyone, no. People respect clothes, not giving
respect to their real beings… Therefore ego asking- because ego only continues up to cemetery, no more-,
enjoying with such imitated things, to show that he is someone or he is something, or she is something… We
speak on characteristics of our egos. Everyone asking to be first one, Nr.1, and they are asking to show to
people or to others through their clothes and medals that they are an important ones, VIP people… la haula
wa la quwatta! That is the source of troubles on earth, because people leave real values and run after imitated
and cheap, very cheap aspects…
May Allah forgive me and bless you… Therefore I am saying here is humble place- even my ego enjoying

himself by saying this is international mental house… With this also my ego happy! 'Doesn't matter', saying,
'even you must be first one, but you may be first crazy one. Doesn't matter, it is not first- I may be first crazy
one on earth. I am asking only to be first one. I am first one for that purpose, it is enough. You may be mental
house first one, doesn't matter.' Ego… terrible creature, dangerous creature, horrible creature! Eating
everyone; eating kings, eating, and finishing emperors, finishing Presidents, finishing and eating everyone
that claming they are VIP ones… finishing them. Only humble ones that they are not claiming to be anything,
their egos can't eat them, even graveyard can't touch them. They should be through their graveyards as they
are buried, and Day of Resurrection they should come like the day they were buried- never going to be durst.
But others all going to be dust… O people, ask Allah! Ask Him!
I looked that ceremony, and Her Majesty Queen was sitting with Her full Adab, full good manners, never
showing to be proud… humbly sitting on a chair, putting like this, standing up and she was keeping her face
and keeping her majestic face and respect to her Lord, yes, like this and standing up and sitting like this…
and it was a big lesson for my ego and for everyone, that what title we may have, we are… in front of our Lord
we must be humble ones, must fall on our knees for respect for the Lord of Heavens, glorifying the Lord of
Heavens. And only Sultanates and Kingdoms giving such a good manners to make people to give their
respects one to each other, and then to learn that the highest position- whether to be King or Queen or
Emperor or Empress, much more praised attribute for them to be humble in their Lord's divinely Presence.
Democracy never teaching such things. Democratic countries you can't find good manners, that mentioned
through holy Books, Old Testament, New Testament, and last Testament Holy Quran, because they are not
using rules of holy Books. But Kings and Queens and Emperors and Empresses keep their high respect for
their Lord through their holy Books. They are coming to their temples, or cathedrals, or Basilicas, and coming
on their knees and showing to their people, citizens, that: 'I am also a servant of my Lord. Don't be proud
come and get on your knees, fall on your knees for glorifying your Lord Allah Almighty'.
May Allah bless her Kingdom and grant her what is most acceptable faith in His divinely Presence, to grant
her and her royal family from here up to Day of Resurrection, for the honor of the most honored Prophet
Sayidinna Muhammad salallahu alayhi wa sallim. Fatiha…
If Sheikh Hisham Effendi Hazretleri approves of what we are saying, that means it is important… Therefore I
am going to be important one, VIP… everywhere VIP, they are putting my name, only Cyprus, no… Leave to

ask to be VIP, leave them, leave your Lord makes you VIP, it is true, or people saying you are VIP no
meaning. To be VIP is from Heavens… Welcome to you, Happy Birthday to me...
Lefke - 04.06.2002
